title: Spectral bounds for distance coloring and packing parameters of graphs via semidefinite programming
summary: Using methods from spectral graph theory and semidefinite programming, we obtain sharp spectral bounds for several graph parameters related to distance colorings and packing, including the injective chromatic number, the open packing number, the injective chromatic index, and the strong chromatic index. The new spectral bounds improve several existing combinatorial bounds.
